Application for an Amendment to the Zoning By-law – 41 Royal Parkside Drive (Ward 4) (File: D30-010-2026)

The purpose of the public meeting is to review an application submitted by The Jones Consulting Group Ltd., on behalf of Kanterra Barrie Inc., for an Amendment to the Zoning By-law that would facilitate the future development of a residential plan of subdivision with 41 townhouse units on lands described as Part of Lot 16, Concession 13, Part 3 on Reference Plan 51R-44753, and known municipally as 41 Royal Parkside Drive, Barrie.
The site is approximately 0.89 hectares in size and located on the south side of Britannic Lane, between Royal Parkside Drive and Queen Elizabeth Parkway, north of Big Bay Point Road. The property has a frontage of approximately 50 metres on Royal Parkside Drive, 41 metres on Queen Elizabeth Parkway, and 166 metres on Britannic Lane. The surrounding uses include single detached residential dwellings to the north and west, the City of Barrie Surface Water Treatment Facility and a mixed-use commercial/residential development to the west fronting Big Bay Point Road, institutional uses to the immediate south, and vacant lands in the Town of Innisfil to the east.
Zoning By-law Amendment
The Zoning By-law Amendment application proposes to rezone the subject lands from ‘Institutional’ (I) to ‘Residential Multiple Dwelling Second Density – Townhouse with Special Provisions’ (RM2-TH) (SP-XXX) in the City of Barrie Comprehensive Zoning By-law 2009-141. The following special provisions are being requested:

Plan of Subdivision
The associated Draft Plan of Subdivision is intended to create six (6) townhouse blocks to be further subdivided for 41 townhouse unit, together with lands to accommodate a new municipal roadway internal to the development.

The purpose of the public meeting is to review an application submitted by The Jones Consulting Group Ltd., on behalf of Lockhart 960 Inc., for an Amendment to the Zoning By-law to permit 125 residential units, consisting of 27 street townhouse units, 80 back-to-back townhouse units, and 18 apartment units within three six-unit walk-up apartment buildings, on lands described as: Part Lot 19, Concession 11, (Innisfil), being Parts 1 & 2 on Plan 51R-10172; Subject to easements as in RO1032569 & IN31298; and known municipally as: 960 Lockhart Road, City of Barrie.
The subject lands are approximately 8.18 hectares in size and are located to the north side of Lockhart Road, west of 20th Sideroad. The property has a frontage of approximately 260 metres on Lockhart Road and currently contains an existing single detached dwelling with accessory buildings.
Zoning By-law Amendment
A Zoning By-law Amendment is proposed to amend the existing ‘Agricultural General’ (AG) zone that applies to the subject lands in the Town of Innisfil Zoning By-law (054-04), as amended, to ‘Neighbourhood Multiple Residential with Special Provisions’ (RM3)(SP-XXX), ‘Neighbourhood Mixed Use with Special Provision 676’ (NMU)(SP-676) and ‘Environmental Protection (EP) in accordance with the following special provisions:
